message.content: {"criteria":[{"id":"C1","level":"Accomplished","mark":8,"evidence":[{"where":"Introduction","quote":"The spacecraft is intended to image and send data to ground stations for collation and analysis."},{"where":"Introduction","quote":"The proposed satellite would likely be used by governmental and science agencies (e.g. CSIRO, BOM) for research and/or education."},{"where":"Introduction","quote":"Thus, only one satellite is required."}],"reasoning":"Primary mission (coral reef/ocean monitoring via fluid lensing), rationale, single-spacecraft justification and users (operator/customers) are all covered with literature references. Some referencing is weak (Wikipedia used for launch data), but overall detailed and persuasive."},{"id":"C2","level":"Adequate","mark":6,"evidence":[{"where":"Orbit","quote":"Specifically, an altitude of 600km requires a mean inclination of 97.7924° for the satellite to remain sun-synchronous."},{"where":"Ground Control & Communications","quote":"An average contact duration of almost ten minutes was achieved"},{"where":"Mission Duration & EOL","quote":"The proposed ZYZZsat is small and without thrusters in a low-earth orbit."}],"reasoning":"Launch site/vehicle, orbit elements, ground station, comms frequency, duration and EOL are addressed with STK evidence. But design has inconsistencies: no comms frequency/link budget, no coverage/swath analysis, EOL drag sail contradicts 'no thrusters' and no manoeuvre quantified, and launch rationale relies on Wikipedia. Adequate but not comprehensive."},{"id":"C3","level":"Adequate","mark":6,"evidence":[{"where":"Conclusion","quote":"A specific launch vehicle – the Vega E – has been selected although it has not been built yet."},{"where":"Conclusion","quote":"The Mt Pleasant Radio Observatory is well-located to receive data from this orbit type constantly and for long durations."}],"reasoning":"Conclusions summarise the design and acknowledge the unbuilt Vega E risk, but are largely generic restatements without quantified outcomes or critical assessment of limitations."},{"id":"C4","level":"Adequate","mark":5,"evidence":[{"where":"Orbit","quote":"[Image 1]"},{"where":"Ground Control & Communications","quote":"DN path for orbits 1-15"},{"where":"Bibliography","quote":"[6] https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2021_in_spaceflight. [Online]."}],"reasoning":"Structure with headings and executive summary is present, but figures are unnumbered/unlabelled (only captions), tables lack titles, references are bare URLs with no author/title/date, Wikipedia is cited, and there are typos ('purposed', 'complied'). Readable but not professional."}],"requirements":[{"id":"R1","met":"yes","where":"Introduction"},{"id":"R2","met":"yes","where":"Introduction"},{"id":"R3","met":"yes","where":"Introduction"},{"id":"R4","met":"yes","where":"Launch"},{"id":"R5","met":"yes","where":"Orbit"},{"id":"R6","met":"partial","where":"Orbit"},{"id":"R7","met":"partial","where":"Ground Control & Communications"},{"id":"R8","met":"yes","where":"Mission Duration & EOL"},{"id":"R9","met":"yes","where":"Introduction"},{"id":"R10","met":"yes","where":"Orbit"},{"id":"R11","met":"no","where":null},{"id":"R12","met":"no","where":null},{"id":"R13","met":"partial","where":"Ground Control & Communications"},{"id":"R14","met":"partial","where":"Mission Design"},{"id":"R15","met":"no","where":"Orbit"},{"id":"R16","met":"partial","where":"Bibliography"}],"technical_issues":[{"where":"Orbit","issue":"RAAN 27.33° is stated to indicate launch facility location, which is incorrect; RAAN is set by launch time/azimuth, not site longitude."},{"where":"Orbit","issue":"No coverage/swath or resolution calculation to justify 600 km altitude; claim that high altitude gives low resolution is stated but not quantified."},{"where":"Ground Control & Communications","issue":"No communication frequency band, data rate or link budget given, despite requirement to state comms frequency."},{"where":"Mission Duration & EOL","issue":"EOL drag sail described but no deorbit time/altitude analysis; text says satellite has no thrusters yet earlier mentions retro-burn options inconsistently."},{"where":"Launch","issue":"Launch vehicle selection relies on Wikipedia '2021 in spaceflight' and an unbuilt Vega E; no delta-V or launch azimuth analysis."},{"where":"Ground Control & Communications","issue":"Access table shows duplicate access 14/15 and a 151 s minimum pass; no assessment of data volume vs contact time."}],"overall":"A competent, well-structured preliminary design covering most requirements with STK evidence, but weakened by missing comms frequency/link budget, no coverage analysis, questionable RAAN rationale, unlabelled figures, poor referencing (Wikipedia) and an under-supported EOL plan. Adequate overall."}
